t: A London Accent from the 14th to the 21st Centuries
desc:
If you'd like to read more about the history of south-eastern English pronunciation, I'd recommend the Cambridge History of the English Language series. I used volumes II and III extensively for this video, but if there are mistakes, they're far more likely to be mine. The chapters on phonology are particularly interesting. 

If you have any specific questions, I'm more than happy to answer them i

recs.stt: How we know languages like proto-Indo-European existed [video]
recs.x:
I thought this might be a Simon Roper video! I really enjoy his deep, humble and creative views on these topics, even though he still describes himself as only an enthusiast. Speaking of creative, check out his "A London Accent from the 14th to the 21st Century"[1] for a frankly enchanting 18 minutes of viewing.

[1] [link]
